reason: A personal news aggregation service that collects online sources, uses an LLM to rank and summarize items, and delivers scheduled digests through configured notification channels.

summaries.zh: 聚合 RSS、Hacker News 等在线来源，使用大语言模型进行筛选和摘要，并通过飞书、Discord 或自定义 HTTP 端点发送新闻摘要。
summaries.en: Aggregates RSS and other online sources, uses a large language model to rank and summarize items, and delivers scheduled digests through Feishu, Discord, or a custom HTTP endpoint.

capabilities: Aggregates RSS and other online news sources
Uses an OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic LLM endpoint to rank and summarize content
Runs scheduled fetching and delivery jobs
Sends digests to Feishu, Discord, or a custom HTTP endpoint
Provides a local web console, HTTP API, and stdio MCP server for configuration and job management
